The '''eopie''' [[Rooh]] produced a '''son''' in the months after the fugitive [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] fled to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] following the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. Kenobi gave him to the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] clan leader [[A'Yark/Legends|A'Yark]] in order to secure the release of [[Jabe Calwell]], who participated in farmer [[Orrin Gault]]'s false flag attack on [[Wyle Ulbreck]]'s farm.<ref name="Kenobi">[[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']]</ref>
